mapper.insert: INSERT INTO carts (user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = updated_at

INSERT INTO cart_items (cart_id, product_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = LEAST(quantity + #{quantity}, 99), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.product_id, i.updated_at AS created_at, '' AS note, i.quantity, p.name AS product_name, p.price, p.thumbnail_url FROM cart_items i JOIN carts c ON c.id = i.cart_id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.created_at, i.id

SELECT i.id, i.product_id, i.updated_at AS created_at, '' AS note, i.quantity, p.name AS product_name, p.price, p.thumbnail_url FROM cart_items i JOIN carts c ON c.id = i.cart_id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND i.id = #{itemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_items SET quantity = #{quantity}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{itemId} AND cart_id IN (SELECT id FROM carts WHERE user_id = #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE cart_id IN (SELECT id FROM carts WHERE user_id = #{userId})
